description.zh: 基于 InstructionX_UIKit Blueprint 的 OpenCV 节点化图像处理蓝图编辑器：20 个节点、exec/data 双链执行引擎、工作线程处理与跨线程预览封送。
description.en: A node-based OpenCV image-processing blueprint editor built on InstructionX_UIKit Blueprint: 20 nodes, an exec/data dual-chain execution engine, worker-thread processing, and cross-thread preview marshalling.
